declarations.name: test.Votes
declarations.description: A test behavior defined with no Rust (D103's step 5), whose rules come from the declarative vocabulary alone: votes on a row, one per voter, each a score from 1 to the config's maxScore; their count, sum, average, highest and lowest, and the count of scores of 3 or more, derived from the votes; flags any caller but the row's owner raises, a counter; an accept only its owner makes, once the votes reach the config's quorum, which moves the row's Workflow; the row's owner kept as its create gave it, and its title frozen once it is accepted; and two reactions, one marking the row quorate and one closing a row flagged three times.

maxScore.description: The highest score a vote gives.

quorum.description: How many votes an accept needs.

fields.name: voteCount
fields.description: How many votes the row has.

fields.name: scoreAverage
fields.description: The mean score; absent before the first vote.

fields.name: topScore
fields.description: The highest score; absent before the first vote.

fields.name: lowScore
fields.description: The lowest score; absent before the first vote.

fields.name: approvals
fields.description: How many votes score 3 or more.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: How many times the row was flagged.

fields.name: quorate
fields.description: Whether the votes reached the quorum once.

tables.name: votes
tables.description: One row per voter: the score and when it came.

operations.name: vote
operations.description: Records the caller's vote, replacing the caller's earlier one.

score.description: The score, 1 to the config's maxScore.

operations.name: flag
operations.description: Flags the row; its owner cannot.

operations.name: accept
operations.description: Moves the row to accepted: its owner's, once the votes reach the quorum.

operations.name: summary
operations.description: Returns the row's votes in figures.

vetoes.description: A vote or a flag of a row that is not open.
A flag by the row's owner.
An accept by a caller other than the row's owner.
An accept before the votes reach the quorum.
A transition into a state while a field the state requires is absent or null, as StateRules vetoes it.
An update that changes a field the row's state freezes, as StateRules vetoes it.
An update that clears a field the row's state requires, as StateRules vetoes it.

guards.message: only an open row takes votes and flags
the row's owner does not flag it
only the row's owner accepts it
the votes have not reached the quorum
